horoscope: The Full Moon today can inflate feelings and emotions, dear Aries, particularly surrounding business or financial matters for you. A conflict over money or power dynamics can reach a head. The solution to conflicts emerging at a Full Moon is to compromise or balance the scales in some way. An imbalance can be obvious now, and it's time to strategize how to correct it. This Full Moon brings feelings to life, and there can be a turning point in a close relationship, with money, or business, and a revelation that leads to new and important ideas in the coming week. Personal resources, talents, money, and issues of sharing come into stronger focus. If you've been investing too much of your energy into something that's just not giving back in satisfying ways, then you'll feel the need to make changes now. With a Sun-Pluto square also in play, particularly around imbalances in your relationships, this can lead to a desire to escape or become a real distraction from what you're doing. Circumstances can reveal where you’ve been overly attached. Ideally, this transit clarifies what steps you can take to free yourself from fear in these areas of life. Consider that micromanaging or obsessing over a problem is likely to be self-destructive right now.

Today's Full Moon occurs in your sign, dear Taurus, and tugs at your emotions, prompting you to prioritize your personal needs and plans. If you've been catering a little too much to others' needs and agendas, you'll feel the need to reclaim some of your independence. Feelings that were left unacknowledged or kept at bay can emerge with strength now. A Full Moon illuminates a matter that already exists, but that has been buried or hidden. There can be unexpected epiphanies and awareness that demands air time. With a Sun-Pluto square also in play, watch for reading too much into a situation. Challenges experienced now may be getting you in better touch with your vulnerabilities, so it’s best to take note. Avoid making quick decisions that are more about fear, guilt, or dread than common sense. Sorting through the truths and deeper emotions that surface now can be helpful. Still, illuminating a tricky subject or a buried frustration is possible. Although it can surface so that you might finally deal with it, look also for ways to build your sense of self-worth, value, security, and comfort rather than dwell on what’s missing.

With a Full Moon occurring in your privacy sector early today, dear Gemini, you might prefer to fade into the background for much-needed time alone, rest, or time to think. New light shines on recent hidden or background trends in your life. You may be filling in some of the blanks of your life now. A secret or private matter may be revealed, a health matter could come to light, or a work project can reach culmination. If you've been working too hard or putting so much effort into helping others that you've ignored your own needs, now is the time to restore some balance to your life. If possible, save major decision-making for another time. Look within for answers, and take your time. With today's Sun-Pluto square also in play, watch for a possible obsession with an idea, problem, or line of thought that doesn't serve you well. Try to let go of attitudes or thought patterns that are too negative to do you any good. If there are looming problems, aim to make improvements without pressuring yourself.

The Full Moon very early today can serve as a potent reminder of your need for friends, associates, support of the community, or like-minded people, dear Cancer. Tensions in your social or romantic life can come to a head, or you may make a discovery or have an epiphany. You can feel a sudden need to detach yourself from personal focus in order to connect with others in meaningful ways. Certainly, events now remind you of the role you play in others' lives, whether you're in high demand, receive a significant invitation, need to help someone out, or experience a sudden rush of feelings about a lover or friend. This can be a time to take a personal inventory of your needs and wants and consider ways to satisfy them or, at the very least, recognize and honor your feelings. Watch, however, for rushing decisions. Differences in opinion or method can be more frustrating than usual today as the Sun and Pluto form a square. Avoid getting caught up in power plays, but consider that triggered spots can be revealing since they are areas of your psyche that need extra attention. Take the pressure off and assume it’s all too easy to make mountains out of molehills with this transit. If you find yourself in a negative space of regret, remember to focus on the one thing you can control in life: your attitude. Aim to harness the energy to think up solutions to ongoing problems.

This is a time for acknowledging your need to perform, lead, and manage, dear Leo, with the Full Moon occurring at the top of your solar chart. This may be a time to recognize unacknowledged needs, make announcements, or bring a project to fruition. Problems and flaws in your plans may come to light now, but this also motivates you to address things you've overlooked or let go of. This is a time to be noticed and acknowledged, and it's best to keep everything above board. You may need to take the lead or go hard with a work project. It's a time of announcements or big reveals. When it comes to personal relationships, though, the past has a way of pulling you in these days, and today it can feel a little uncomfortable. With today's Sun-Pluto square also in play, tension can linger until you identify the fears or frustrations behind any stress you may be feeling. Part of you craves lighthearted, fun connections and projects, but another part seeks something more profound. If you're holding on to resentments, they might surface in unexpected ways now.

With the Full Moon today, dear Virgo, something may come to light that changes your perspective and focus, lifting your concerns above and beyond the routine. It can encourage you to look at the big picture or to reach higher and wider. Unmet and unspoken needs can demand a platform now. This Full Moon illuminates a matter related to learning, sharing, and connecting, as it occurs in your sector of adventure and spirit. An important project may come to a turning point, or you're feeling ready to share it. You may be prompted to explore your needs for more adventure, learning, and expansion in your life. You've had a busy time with your daily affairs, and now you recognize the need for a little more. With a Sun-Pluto square also in play, fears or worries can surface. Tension emerges if you or someone in your life is holding on too tightly to a belief or method. Whether you’re the one who is trying to control a situation or someone is attempting to control you, the root problem is fear of change, and you may want to nip it in the bud. We may be thinking in extremes or listening too closely to our worries today. Communications and thoughts or memories can open up old emotional issues and challenges. Intense emotions may motivate you to protect your interests more effectively, so aim to connect with them, but take the pressure off to resolve the problem immediately. Learn from trigger points today, as they can point you toward what is most in need of repair and healing.

The Full Moon early today can pull up an issue surrounding debts, obligations, investments, sharing, or support, dear Libra. If you've been dependent on people or things in unhealthy ways, you're bound to truly see and acknowledge it now, motivating you to make changes and improvements. Emotional discoveries can lead to important ideas and ventures in the coming week. The solution is to look for compromises that can lead to a new understanding of yourself or a relationship. This lunation also presents an opportunity to release yourself from something that has been weighing you down or preventing you from growing. While emotions run rather high today, there is a way to get back to reality. This might involve swinging between extremes until the middle ground is found, but you'll get there! Note that a Sun-Pluto square is also in play today, and it can magnify worries. The trick is to be moderate since going overboard can lead to unnecessary pressure. Try not to push yourself too hard! Be sure to avoid making decisions based on mixed perceptions of the moment.

Today's Full Moon can bring a personal or relationship matter to a head, dear Scorpio. There can be personal epiphanies and relationship drama now. If you've been ignoring certain needs and emotions, these things demand your attention today (and this week). You might verbalize or acknowledge a situation/feeling, and it's a powerful discovery. A relationship might reach a turning point or get to a whole new level. This is a time for learning about what you need and want from others.  Try not to be ruled by the tension of a Sun-Pluto square that's also in play today. It’s best not to push yourself to solve long-standing problems all at once since it’s unrealistic. A step-by-step approach is best. Attempts to over-control or micromanage people and things can be a warning sign that you're overly attached. Easing this pressure, even a little, can be helpful. Fortunately, it's a good time to identify your vulnerable areas and resolve to work on strengthening these areas.

The Full Moon very early today can bring a work, health, or private matter to light or to a turning point for you, dear Sagittarius. Recently, you have been doing a lot of looking within, withdrawing, and possibly escaping, and today's lunation reminds you of your obligations, both to others (work, services) and to yourself (self-care programs, health regimes). Something could come due, a job might require extra attention, or a wellness matter might prompt further investigation. Pay attention to hunches and clues, but keep in mind that the emotions of the day can magnify issues. Today’s Sun-Pluto square can magnify worries, especially in the first half of the day.

You can experience a creative rush, strongly romantic or affectionate feelings, or a compelling need to express your feelings with the Full Moon occurring very early today, dear Capricorn. You might want to get something off your chest, as unacknowledged feelings and needs surface. This is a time for something playful, fun, self-expressive, and creative, even with tensions experienced between what you think you should be doing and what you feel. Learning what's in your heart is necessary before you can follow your heart, and that's what you're exploring now. Feelings that you've brushed aside or left unacknowledged can come rushing to the surface. A project, or even a friendship, can reach a turning point. Also today, a Sun-Pluto square can incline you to read too much into people's actions and words. If you fear the worst, it can be tempting to seek the worst because you don’t want it to catch you off guard!

Today's Full Moon lights up your personal life and pulls your attention to domestic matters, dear Aquarius. This is a time for honoring your need for a safe, comfortable, and supportive base. If you've been pouring too much energy into work responsibilities or the outside world, the day's and week's events will show you the need to return to balance. If you've been overextending yourself, you need to find ways to get more rest. As well, if you've been going it alone and making executive decisions, your need for support from loved ones is highlighted now. There can be an epiphany about family or security matters. Today's Sun-Pluto challenge can pull up buried frustration, perhaps in disruptive ways. Still, it can put you in the right frame of mind to sort things out. Tame your inclination to dwell on the negative aspects of your life unless you're ready to act on problem areas. You or someone close to you may feel a little threatened by potential changes, which can be a natural reaction, but talking things through can help settle your mind. With this transit, it's best to ask ourselves whether we're pushing for the truth or just power-tripping! Make plans to improve your life rather than dwell on past mistakes. Find ways to loosen up and relax, and if this means removing yourself from tense situations, do so if you can. Fortunately, this becomes far easier as the day advances.

Today's Full Moon occurs in your solar third house of communication, dear Pisces. A little drama may arise in your immediate environment, possibly your neighborhood, or from news you receive or share. This is typically a time to reap the rewards of recent projects or learning efforts, and that may be the case now, but you may first face a small disappointment or hurdle. This is an excellent time to examine your communication skills and how they are helping or hindering you. If you often find that people misunderstand your intentions when you communicate, this is a good time to see what you can change to get your message across more effectively. When it comes to your relationships, you may feel a little vulnerable or insecure, as if others are triggering your more sensitive nature. Observe rather than make bold relationship moves now. Concerns about a goal, work project, or function can magnify today, with a Sun-Pluto square also in play. Watch for regrettable behavior stemming from fears of being out of the loop. While you may be frustrated with people who seem to have an agenda, you have the power to rise above it and focus on doing your best. You can’t control others, but you can control where you put your energies. Aim to go forward with the resolve to manage your life more efficiently. Doubts are possible today, but these can help you to identify weaker areas that can use a bit of strengthening. Activities that connect you with your feelings can bring notable benefits.
